detail: The customs house answers two questions: 1. Is the thing as its manifest says? — entry, weigh, strike, search. 2. What is the thing allowed to do on the road? — rate, band, seal. Everything downstream (rate, band, seal, clearance) is arithmetic on the box. No box, no clearance; the counter refuses politely, by name.
note: The two questions define the customs house's entire function. Nothing else happens here.
